description: This file defines API endpoints for the Dashboard in a FastAPI application, including functions to retrieve dashboard statistics and recent activity related to projects, bugs, and audit logs.

classes.name: DashboardStats
classes.description: Schema/model representing dashboard statistics, including project counts, bug counts, and recent activity.

classes.name: ActivityItem
classes.description: Schema/model representing a single activity log entry with details like user, action, timestamp, etc.

classes.name: UserResponse
classes.description: Schema/model representing the user data returned upon authentication or user-related queries.

methods.name: get_dashboard_stats( current_user: UserResponse = Depends(get_current_active_user), db = Depends(get_database) )
methods.description: Asynchronous function that retrieves statistics for the user's dashboard, such as project and bug counts, and recent activity.

methods.name: get_recent_activity( limit: int = 50, current_user: UserResponse = Depends(get_current_active_user), db = Depends(get_database) )
methods.description: Asynchronous function that returns a list of recent activity items accessible to the user, limited by a specified number.

ctags.name: get_recent_activity
ctags.signature: ( limit: int = 50, current_user: UserResponse = Depends(get_current_active_user), db = Depends(get_database) )
